fields.title: 5. Proposed New Rules — None
fields.md:
The local abatement application has no figures yet for its profit-and-loss or financing path. Whether to set up a probability rule on whether events that block self-generation permits (abatement rejection, permit denial, moratorium legislation) delay compute expansion will be decided together with **the new Axis E data center environmental regulation milestones (monthly share)**. Existing proposals ①~⑤ are maintained (Source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied`).
